steps.text: Rhodes Island Bioengineering Lab
10:00 A.M. \ Sunny, clear
Weedy?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, sorry, sorry.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I used the disinfectant spray at the door... and I wasn't doing any experiments before I came...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm coming in, okay? I don't wanna hear any whining that I smell like machine oil this time.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Anyway, your contract's almost up, and they make us do an interview before we can renew it. I brought the draft for the new one.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Not much has changed, really; just trying to get HR off my back.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hello? Anybody home?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Dang, I forgot. Weedy and Blaze always do physical training at this hour. Guess I'm off to the training grounds.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Over here, Luli.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Sorry I'm late. I almost didn't recognize you.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Is that so? Speaking of which, if I didn't know any better I'd think you were born and raised in Columbia.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: I have spent an awful long time in Trimounts, after all. We haven't seen each other since Iberia, have we?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I was in the audience when you gave Rhine Lab's presentation at the last Trimounts Bioengineering Frontier Conference.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I was going to meet you after the session, but I had to leave for an emergency call from the Medical Department.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: So you were the Rhodes Island representative who had to withdraw?

spans.text: were the Rhodes Island representative who had to withdraw?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: We'd just taken in a batch of patients in critical condition, and they needed my expertise.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: You do realize how competitive that conference is, don't you? There are so many universities and tech companies fighting for those slots.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Spike the temperature to herd the enemy where you want them, then finish 'em off with the chainsaw.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Blaze! Got a moment?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, Closure. How'd you like my move just now?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Spicy. It's just you here, though? Where's Weedy?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: We cancelled today's training.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Why?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I thought it was about yesterday at first.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yesterday, huh...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Careful!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: At these temperatures—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: No need to hold back. I want to test the limits of the water cannon post-modification.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Can you take the recoil though?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Should be fine. It's a chance to put that physical training to the test.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Get ready, Leaf!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What...? Did you... knock her out?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No! Nothing to do with that! She cancelled to go see an old friend.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh yeah?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: A Rhine Lab employee, apparently.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: She never told me about that...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wait, Rhine Lab?! And that didn't raise any alarm bells for you?!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Weedy was one of the first to join Rhodes Island, her contract's about to expire, and I've been trying in vain to track her down these past few days.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And now she's meeting with an old buddy from Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: On top of all that, just the other day she got injured while training with a certain someone.

spans.text: of all that, just the other day she got injured while training with a certain someone.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, she wasn't injured! I know it looked bad, but I took her to Medical for a full checkup.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Either way, all signs point to...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No way.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I sure hope not.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Seriously, why would you swing for the fences in training? Don't you know how strong you are?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Weedy knocked me back too, you know... She's gotten a lot stronger and more skilled.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Excuse me, miss.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Could you please move this, er... gun? It's blocking the passageway.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Oh, sorry about that.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: What's that, Weedy?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It's a water cannon that can shoot water at various pressures, or even as high-temperature steam jets.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It can be used as a portable energy source, which is useful for localized testing of the landship's automation upgrades.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Looks more like a weapon to me. That shoots people with high-pressure water jets. Or steam, apparently.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Well, yes, combat was another application it was designed for.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Researchers need weapons too.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Why on Terra would the head of Rhodes Island's bioengineering lab ever have to fight? Do they not assign security forces for their researchers?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: That's not what I meant.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I had the idea of building a water cannon back when I was still in Iberia.

a.text: When the Inquisition came to Abuelo's lab.
They confiscated all his documents and materials.
My grandfather's life's work, what would have been the first thesis in Iberia, indeed in all Terra, to detail the changes in the ocean from a combined biological and engineering perspective.
Abuelo's research license was suspended. All further research was subject to direct review by the Inquisition.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I would sometimes wonder, could I have blasted them out of his lab if I'd had a weapon like this back then?

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: You'd need more than a water cannon to deal with the Inquisition.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Yes, it was just the fancy of a child. That's why I mostly use it for construction and development.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Oops, I almost forgot we had business to attend to.

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: You were looking for me, Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Is your boss back yet?

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: No. Weedy went—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Yeah, I know. I didn't see her at the lab.

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: The bioengineering lab is out of service right now.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: Don't you remember? You came in without disinfecting last time, causing the contamination detection alarm to go off and—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey, I cleaned up right away, didn't I?

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: Yes, you used one of the hand-wash stations, putting the entire water sanitation system out of commission.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's not my fault Weedy turned the detection AI's sensitivity all the way up!

spans.text: fault Weedy turned the detection AI's sensitivity all the way up!

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: Regardless, she decided to fully disinfect the lab and let it idle for a week before reopening it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Someday we'll need to have a talk about how her mysophobia intersects with laboratory regulations.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wait, but won't that delay your latest project?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Didn't Weedy submit a bunch of reports and funding applications just last week?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, crap, I think I forgot to approve them...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Weapon upgrades for the training grounds... procurement for the Logistics Department... bridge repairs...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I could swear I left them right here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Crap, don't tell me I misplaced her applications.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Lab out of service, new projects not getting approved... She must be tearing her hair out by now. Do you know what she's been up to lately?

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: She received a package that seemed to contain some kind of research materials from an old friend. She's been going over them in her quarters.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: An old friend? The same one who works for Rhine Lab? The one she's meeting today?

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: Yes, that one.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So she's already helping other companies with their projects.

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: She's already made up her mind then...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh jeez, how am I going to explain this to Kal'tsit and Amiya?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Come to think of it, she's had a hand in half of Rhodes Island's automation projects...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: She's one of our oldest employees, but never gets the attention she deserves. Can't blame her for keeping her resume up-to-date.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Heck, the only reason she came here in the first place is that we were the first to make an offer.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I've failed her as both a supervisor and a colleague...

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: What are you talking about, Closure?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Do you know where Weedy is meeting her friend?

steps.name: Assistant Operator
steps.text: A bar, I think.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Oops, I almost forgot we had business to attend to.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I've looked through the documents you sent me.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Specifically, I made some corrections to the section on beachfront engineering based on Ægir technology, referencing the models and theories from Abuelo's manuscripts.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Thanks, Weedy. You're the only one I could think of when it comes to this stuff.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Rhine Lab has experts on all sorts of things, but not on the ocean or the Ægir.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: No problem, it was nothing.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I've been away from Iberia for a while, though, so there might be new variables I haven't taken into account. I can't guarantee 100% accuracy.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: That's fine, I'll cross-check them in the field. I just wanted to gather all the materials I could pertaining to the current state of research, before I go back to Iberia.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You're going back to Iberia?!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Why so suddenly?

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: I was visited by a Messenger from the Inquisition last month.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: The Inquisition...

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: They brought a research proposal on maritime engineering, a handwritten letter from an Inquisitor, and an entrance permit into Iberia issued by the Inquisition.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: The documents you went over were part of that research.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: So they're opening up research into the ocean to outsiders...

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Yes. Iberia is seeking change.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Have you made up your mind?

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Yes, that one.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: But you've spent so much time at Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: I'll be turning in my resignation. There's a lot of red tape involved, though. Project handovers, non-compete clauses, etc. Exactly what you'd expect from a big company.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: But Iberia is in my blood. No matter how far away I go, I'll always smell the scent of brine in the air, and follow it back to Iberia.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: There were two reasons I came here. The first was to hand over the responsibilities of the Rhine Lab liaison. The second was to seek you out.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You want me to come back to Iberia with you.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'm sorry, Luli, but I can't.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Because of Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Forgive me for being frank, but Rhodes Island is hardly the ideal employer.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Due to their focus on clinical application, and involvement in crises across Terra, the resources they can offer for your research are limited.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: And not only did they make you pull out of the Trimounts Bioengineering Frontier Conference, apparently you have to fill in for armed personnel?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Well, as I've already explained—

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Your contract with them is about to expire, too.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Rhodes Island isn't what you think it is, Luli.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: You still have chip on your shoulder about Iberia, don't you? Because of what happened to your grandfather?

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Didn't you use to say that 'limitations on science are always set by people'?

spans.text: Didn't you use to say that 'limitations on science are always set by

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Those were Abuelo's words. I tried very hard to convince him to leave Iberia, but he never did.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Science is the exploration of the unknown, but those who passionately throw themselves into it will find many locked drawers in front of them. The ocean, the Ægir, the Profound Silence...

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: No researcher could possibly enjoy an Iberia like that.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: But Weedy, the tide has come ashore, reaching up to Iberia's ankles, and threatens to drown all of it.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: So I've heard from our newer Iberian operators.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: We can demand that the Inquisition release your grandfather's research. After all, it's closely linked to the maritime engineering project they sent over.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Iberia needs to seek change. The locks on those drawers are opening up, one by one.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: But I can't go back with you right now.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: For the reason you brought up before tossing it aside: I need to stay at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Abuelo hated Iberia, and he hated the Inquisition, for laying waste to his life's work in an instant.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: But he wouldn't leave the country, even after his research license was revoked.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I thought it was because he was old and didn't feel like going through the effort of starting over.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: But there's no such thing as a utopia for scientific freedom. Far too many scientists have died in exile.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Later, I began to understand that he simply wanted to keep defending what he loved doing. He was waiting for the locks to open, to pick his research back up.

a.text: Science is the exploration of the unknown, Weedy.
There will always be blanks, and places that are off-limits.
One blank gets filled in, and another appears. The frontiers are endless.
And no matter where you go, there will always be somewhere off-limits.
Limitations on science are always set by people, but it's also people who break those restraints. Passionate people.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Congratulations. You passed our tests. Welcome to the team.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You say tests... It was one interview.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Eh, we're a start-up. We need all the talent we can get.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It took a lot of convincing to get Amiya to set up a bioengineering lab. You're the only member right now, so we're counting on you to make something of it! No pressure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Of course, we'll give you all the support we can, in terms of funding, equipment, experiments... Anything you need, just say the word.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Just one thing... do you think we could negotiate on your requirement to wash our hands an average of 10 times every 3 hours?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey, what's with that look on your face?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: The operation went well.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Great.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's all thanks to your help fixing the sickbay's automation equipment.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I'm really sorry we had to call you back like this. That was an important conference, wasn't it? You spent so much time on that thesis.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It's okay. All five Infected are out of danger, right?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: By the way, there's a child who wants to chat with your bionic seadragon. She says you promised her before the operation.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Right. I'll head in now.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Are you sure? You must be tired.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sorry, I should've been more careful. You hurt anywhere?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You could just focus on your experiments, you know.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Weren't you the one who said I needed to build up my constitution?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What I mean is you don't have to fight.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Surgery and experiments can solve only a small part of the Oripathy problem, as—

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Enough lectures, sheesh. Just stay behind me, alright? The battlefield can be chaotic, but I'll take out all the enemies before you're in any danger.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Don't underestimate an industrial water cannon.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'm staying at Rhodes Island for the same reason that Abuelo wouldn't leave his lab, and the same reason you've chosen to return to Iberia.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It's not because I'm afraid of restrictions in a far-away land, but because there's something here that I'm passionate about, which I feel is important to carry on.

steps.name: Waiter
steps.text: Excuse me, miss...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Closure?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Please Weedy, won't you reconsider?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Reconsider... what?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You know how excited Blaze gets in battle. She didn't mean it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And you know I get a little hare-brained when things get busy.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I didn't reject those funding applications you sent last week, I just misplaced them!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Heck, I still remember the titles! 'Connecting Heterogenous Arts Units,' 'Reengineering Ægir Maritime Technology Through Lighthouse Components'... they have a lot of potential.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: (Maritime technology...)

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Misplaced?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You signed them on the spot and handed them back to me. Did you forget?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh... Well, anyway, I want you to give serious consideration to staying at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Er... did you think I was going to leave?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: HR was pressing me to get your contract renewal done, but I just couldn't find you. You weren't at the lab, either.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Luli's going back to Iberia, so I came to see her off. Oh, I forgot. This is Luli, from Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: About to resign from Rhine Lab, actually. I'm Luli. Let's just say Weedy and I are fellow countrymen.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Resign? So you're not...?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ahem. I'm Closure, head of Rhodes Island's Engineering Department, and Weedy's supervisor and friend.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm not interrupting anything, am I?

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: No, we were just about done.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: I think I understand your choice, Weedy. I'll respect it.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: And it looks like you do plan to...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Right, just not now. Thanks for coming to see me. Have a safe trip.

steps.name: Luli
steps.text: Bye bye.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Bye.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Wait, you said you went into the bioengineering lab today?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Er, yeah.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Didn't you know it needed to be put into idle cycle for a week after being disinfected?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Closure!
